purpose: Teach: 重厚/緑茶/木星/レンガ/交響楽/ブドウ/焼き鳥/安楽

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの家具は重厚なテーブルがあるのよ
lines.en: Sho, I have this wonderfully heavy table at my place.
lines.style: Warm, inviting. Like she's sharing something she's thought about. Soft on his name. Slight nostalgic pause before describing the table. Voice settles comfortably.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママと緑茶アイス食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I had green-tea ice cream with Mom!
lines.style: Bright, eager leap forward. Quick tempo. Pitch lifts on the surprise. Wants her to know immediately, like he's been holding this in. Small excited breath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと木星を観測しに行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't we go stargazing with your dad sometime?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not pushing. Warm invitation. Slow, thoughtful pace. The 'why don't we' lands softly — she's making space for him to say yes or no.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ママとレンガ造りのお家見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a brick house with Mom!
lines.style: Rushing to share. Quick and bright. Pitch high with excitement. Same energy as before — he's been collecting moments to tell her. Breathless slightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと交響楽団の演奏会に行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, would you like to come hear the symphony with me?
lines.style: Unhurried, genuine. She's offering something she loves. Warm tone, patient pacing. A small emphasis on 'would you like' — she cares about his answer, not the invitation itself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ブドウの皮、上手にむけたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I peeled the grapes all by myself!
lines.style: Proud, bright declaration. Chest lifted slightly in the voice. Pace quickens on the accomplishment. Wants her to recognize what he did. Small triumph in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと焼き鳥屋に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go to the yakitori place with your dad, shall we?
lines.style: Warm suggestion, settled and easy. Soft 'shall we' at the end — conversational, not directive. She's folding him into something she thinks will be good. Gentle rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんが安楽椅子に座ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa's sitting in his armchair over there!
lines.style: Close, intimate observation shared just with her. Softer tempo than the earlier shouts. Points with his voice — 'over there.' Like he's noticed something and wanted her to see it too. Genuine pleasure.
